newsitem.title: USA: AmeriNet extends U.S. Surgical agreement.
newsitem.headline: AmeriNet extends U.S. Surgical agreement.

text.p: AmeriNet said Tuesday it extended its supply agreement with U.S. Surgical Corp for another two years.

AmeriNet, a health care purchasing cooperative, said the previous agreement generated sales of more than $100 million in each of the last two years. The new pact, which includes the full U.S. Surgical product line, expires January 31, 2000.
AmeriNet said the latest contract extension carries their relationship with U.S. Surgical into a fifteenth year.
U.S. Surgical is a manufacturer of wound closure products.
Its stock was down 1/4 Tuesday at 37-7/8.
